client_summary: Snapchat spent $4,768.23 in the last 30 days (+27.2% on the month before) across prospecting, retargeting and one traffic campaign.
It brought 350 sign-ups at $12.31 each ($10.36 the month before) and 553 visits to the salon page.
The one change for next month: stop paying 1.8 times as much for sign-ups on the Between Stories squad, and move that money to automatic placements.

rows.metric: Results: sign-ups (conversion_sign_ups, goal PIXEL_SIGNUP, 3 ad squads)
Results: landing page views (landing_page_views, goal LANDING_PAGE_VIEW, 1 ad squad)

scorecard.why: 3 campaigns, 4 ad squads and 7 ads are active, all approved and delivering. Every squad spent at least 77% of its budget capacity, with spend on every day. The retargeting squad reached each person 4.62 times in 30 days, above 4, and its swipe-up rate fell every full week: 1.50%, 1.45%, 1.38%, 1.33%.

scorecard.area: Measurement: Snap Pixel and Conversions API
scorecard.key_number: 1 of 4 website ad squads has no pixel
scorecard.why: 'Salon pros | Landing page views' sends swipes to the salon page with no pixel_id, so its $459.88 buys page views but nothing after them is counted. The three sign-up squads carry the pixel and record sign-ups. Swipe to page: 73% to 84% of swipes load the page, above the 50% line. Pixel page views are 91% of landing page views on the sign-up squads. Conversions API: unknown through this connection.

scorecard.key_number: weak hook holds 27% of 'Sign-ups | Prospecting' spend
scorecard.why: 'Image | Feature list' swipes up at 0.36%, under half the campaign's impression-weighted 0.77%, and people watch it for 1.3 s against 2.4 s or more on the videos. It takes 27% of the campaign's spend, above the 25% warn line. No Story ads, so no story opens or position stats.

scorecard.key_number: 4 video ads; lowest share of views reaching 25%: 63%
scorecard.why: Every video ad keeps at least half of its views to the first quartile, so the openings hold. The biggest step down is start to 25% on all 4 (34% to 37% of views leave); after that the curves fall slowly to 29% to 35% completion. On the 20-second video, 37% of views reach 15 seconds across its 3 ads.

scorecard.key_number: Between Stories only: $27.14 a sign-up against $15.48 on automatic
scorecard.why: Same goal and same interest targeting: 'Interests | Between Stories only' (CUSTOM, INTERSTITIAL_USER) costs 1.75 times 'Interests | Automatic placements' per sign-up, above the 1.5 times warn line. The retargeting squad is left out of the comparison because it reaches warm site visitors.

The retargeting squad targets 'Website visitors 30 days' (41,000 users) and excludes paying customers; it costs $4.95 a sign-up against $18.72 on the interest squads. 'Lookalike: sign-ups, US' (1,600,000 users) is ready but unused. Interest ids SLC_71, SLC_84 are shown as ids. Age, gender and location split: unknown through this connection.

4 full weeks, with the last 2 days dropped as a partial week. First full week to last: 'Sign-ups | Prospecting' $19.06 to $18.50 (-3%); 'Sign-ups | Retargeting' $4.61 to $5.41 (+17%); 'Traffic | Salon industry page' $0.82 to $0.84 (+2%). All under the 25% warn line, though retargeting is climbing with its frequency.
No CATALOG_SALES campaign and no ad squad with product_properties.

grade_math: 100 - 5 x 4 warns - 12 x 0 fails = 80; 1 of 8 areas not used (catalog), which costs nothing. 80 needs work.

campaign_draft.plan: One paused sign-up campaign, one ad squad at $40.00 a day optimising for PIXEL_SIGNUP on the lookalike, one creative with headline 'Clients book you while you work' on the best ad's video, and one ad. It starts 2026-11-02 once you switch it on.
before_you_approve: If Snapchat refuses the ad squad without bid_micro, what is the most you would pay per sign-up? I'd put it in bid_micro and retry step 2 only.
The creative uses the Public Profile already on your live creatives (9f0f11e0-0000-4000-8000-000000000001). Say if you want a different profile.
campaign_draft.if_a_step_is_refused: I stop at that step, quote the error and report what was created. Everything created is paused, so it spends nothing; this connection can't delete, so leftovers are removed in Snapchat Ads Manager.

payloads.why: objective_v2_properties copied from 'Sign-ups | Prospecting', the account's own sign-up campaign; no campaign budget, so the squad budget paces it, as on the live campaigns

The pixel is attached and records sign-ups on the live squads, so the squad optimises for PIXEL_SIGNUP with the same pixel_id. Geos and ages copied from 'Interests | Automatic placements'; the interests are replaced by the lookalike 'Lookalike: sign-ups, US' (1,600,000 users), with site visitors and paying customers excluded so this squad doesn't pay for people the retargeting squad already reaches. Automatic placements, because the Between Stories squad costs 1.8 times as much per sign-up. bid_strategy AUTO_BID copied from the live squads, which have no bid_micro, so bid_micro is left out. The helper lists bid_micro as required, so this may be refused; if it is, step 2 is retried with the fallback bid cap you give under before_you_approve, and the paused campaign from step 1 is reused.
